findings.title: Security group sg-0aa11bb22cc33dd44 (legacy-bastion) accepts traffic from the internet

findings.title: Bucket acme-public-assets is readable from the internet

findings.recommendation: Enable Block Public Access at the bucket and account level, then serve anything genuinely public through CloudFront with an origin access identity.
